📖 How to use

  1. Enter a length value in the first field.
  2. Pick the unit you are converting from.
  3. Pick the unit you want to convert to.
  4. Read the result and the full conversion table for all eight units.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which length units are supported?

Millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards and miles.

How accurate are the conversions?

They use exact international definitions — for example 1 inch = 2.54 cm exactly and 1 mile = 1609.344 m exactly.

Why does the table sometimes show many decimals?

Converting a large unit to a small one (miles to millimeters) produces big numbers, so the table keeps up to 6 decimals to stay precise.
